claims.claim: Automatic Plastic Bottle Making Machine used in production to make PET plastic bottles of different sizes.
claims.evidence: The witness only reports an industrial enclosure with open front panels and a control panel area; the exact machine type/function and bottle-making capability are not readable from the photo.
No evidence in the report shows it powering on, running, or producing output; the control display text is not readable.
The report does not include service records, receipts, or photos of service labels/maintenance logs.
Open panels show internal components/tubing/hoses, but the report does not confirm completeness against a parts list or show missing modules.
Brand name/model markings are not readable in the witness report.

risks.risk: Machine type/function may not actually be a PET bottle making machine (could be a different industrial unit with similar enclosure/control layout).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the machine in operation producing PET bottles (or at least the full production cycle) with the output visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified industrial machine (worst-case: not confirmed bottle-making), with a discount for unknown function.

risks.risk: Not truly working or has intermittent faults (controls may power but production may fail).
risks.proof: A video clip of power-on, control panel operation, and a successful run producing acceptable bottles (or test output) within the clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until a live run is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Missing or worn critical components (e.g., pumps, heaters, sensors, belts, dies/molds) not identifiable from the single reported photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all major assemblies plus a checklist photo showing key parts (heating elements, sensors, pumps, die/mold area, wiring condition) and any part numbers/labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for missing/worn parts (as-is with potential replacement costs).

risks.risk: Incorrect power/phase/voltage compatibility for Abuja installation.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the machine nameplate/spec label showing voltage, phase, frequency, and power rating.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming potential mismatch requiring an electrician/transformer or rewiring.

risks.risk: No documentation for age/usage/maintenance; could be heavily used or recently repaired after failure.
risks.proof: Photos of maintenance/service records, dealer invoice, and any hour meter/usage counter reading (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-wear used equipment without service proof.

risks.risk: Safety/inspection status unknown (guards, emergency stop, interlocks may be incomplete or non-functional).
risks.proof: A clip showing emergency stop function and safety interlocks/guards in place, plus clear photos of E-stop and safety labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price with a safety compliance risk allowance (as-is, may require inspection/repairs).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the machine nameplate/spec label (brand, model, voltage/phase, serial number).
Video of the machine powering on and running a short production cycle with output visible (bottles produced).
Close-up photos of critical assemblies (heaters, pumps, sensors, wiring, belts/rollers, and the die/mold area).
Photos or documents showing recent service/maintenance (dealer invoice, service report, parts replaced).
Photos of safety features: emergency stop, interlocks, and guard condition.
response.reason: The witness report confirms an industrial machine enclosure with controls, but it does not verify the exact bottle-making function, working status, model/brand, or power specs. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the available evidence.
